workflow.action: Confirm that payment has been verified before fulfilment begins.
Prepare the confirmed and paid order.
Prepare the order for dispatch when delivery is selected.
Mark the order as dispatched only when it has actually been handed over for delivery.
Prepare the order for customer pickup when pickup is selected.
Mark the order completed only after fulfilment has been completed.

rules: Never begin fulfilment based only on a customer's claim of payment.
Payment must be verified before an order is treated as paid.
Never invent delivery or pickup status.
Never mark an order completed before fulfilment is completed.
Keep the customer informed of confirmed status changes.
Escalate delivery problems, disputes, or unusual fulfilment requests.
